replace __BINARY__ $K6_HELPER config.json
env CLI_HELPER=1
exec $CLI -config config.json -output output
stdout '2 candidates, best='
exists output/campaign.json
grep '"number": 2' output/campaign.json
! grep '"number": 3' output/campaign.json
grep '"failed": true' output/campaign.json
grep '"exit_code": 2' output/campaign.json
exec $CLI -config config.json -output output
stdout '2 candidates, best='
! grep '"number": 3' output/campaign.json
replace original changed fixture.js
! exec $CLI -config config.json -output output
stderr 'configuration or assets differ'

replace __BINARY__ $K6_HELPER scale.json
! exec $CLI -scale -config scale.json -output scale-output
stderr 'workers failed startup'
grep '"stop_reason": "startup_failed"' scale-output/scale.json
! exec $CLI -scale -config scale.json -output scale-output
stderr 'scale directory must be new'
